params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia's banned-chip saga widens: Chinese AI models, Malaysia and the US Treasury Researchers allege DeepSeek, Kimi and other Chinese AI models were trained on export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell GPUs, citing a statistical analysis of model weights. Malaysia plans a law that tracks AI GPU imports and data-center power use to catch smugglers, though power variance and no physical audits could weaken it. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent questioned whether Nvidia knowingly sold restricted chips to shell companies, saying the company itself is responsible. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 17:50 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: Tom's Hardware · Tom's Hardware · Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia ⚖️ Should Nvidia be held responsible?
